title: Wines I've Tried
description: A personal reference transcribed and expanded from a wine list the user uploaded. Restaurant/list descriptions and independent sommelier suggestions are clearly distinguished.

wines.intro: Playful ancestral-method sparkling red with fizzy berry fruit and a savory edge.
wines.nose: Hibiscus, strawberry candy and bubble gum.
wines.palate: Juicy red plum skin and bright berries with lively bubbles.
wines.aeration: Chill, open carefully and serve immediately for its gentle sparkle.
wines.personalNote: Ancestral-method Lambrusco with hibiscus, strawberry candy, bubblegum and red plum skins; the playful label is by a child named Willow.
wines.pairingBasis: Suggested pairing: the wine's bubbles and acidity cut through rich cured meat and cheese.
wines.sourceLabel: Grape Witches Denny Bini Willa cuvée details
wines.imageVintageNote: Actual Willa label photographed; retailers list the wine as non-vintage, while your list calls it 2023.
wines.vintageNote: Treat 2023 as the year recorded on your wine list, not an independently confirmed vintage.

wines.intro: An orange Chardonnay from Mendoza with floral lift, phenolic grip and refreshing acidity.
wines.nose: Orange blossom, waxed lemon, beeswax and tropical white fruit.
wines.palate: Textural, lightly tannic and medium-to-full, with citrus peel and a juicy saline edge.
wines.aeration: Serve cool, not icy; a large white-wine glass shows its skin-contact texture.
wines.personalNote: Deep gold, perfumed skin-contact Chardonnay: waxed lemon, beeswax and orange blossom, with a gripping, juicy finish. The list notes organic farming, vegan production and no added sulfites.
wines.pairingBasis: Suggested for the wine's skin-contact tannin and citrus freshness; regional producer advice also recommends savory Argentine dishes.
wines.imageVintageNote: Exact El Zorrito Naranjo label; printed vintage may differ from 2024.
wines.vintageNote: The uploaded tasting note says about 40 days on skins; other winemaker/importer documents cite approximately 45 days.

wines.intro: A copper-pink natural wine sitting stylistically between a rosé and an orange wine.
wines.nose: Prickly pear, dried herbs, thyme and potpourri.
wines.palate: Fragrant, spicy and lightly smoky, with assertive acidity.
wines.finish: Fresh and savory, with a smoky-herbal impression.
wines.aeration: Serve cool; let the wine open in the glass before judging its herbal notes.
wines.personalNote: An aromatic, spicy and smoky Chilean wine, described as halfway between rosé and orange wine, with prickly pear, thyme, potpourri and pronounced acidity.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for aromatic skin-contact fruit and savory acidity.
wines.sourceLabel: Grape Witches Strange Grapes Nextdoor Rosie
wines.imageVintageNote: Verified Nextdoor Rosie cuvée photograph, not verified as a 2020 label.
wines.vintageNote: 2020 is preserved from the uploaded list; no independent confirmation that this product photo matches that vintage.

wines.intro: A rare dry Moscato with fragrant flowers, a brief skin maceration and a salty coastal finish.
wines.palate: Fully dry, lightly textured, with savory fruit and subtle coastal salinity.
wines.aeration: Serve lightly chilled; avoid ice-cold temperatures that mute the aromatics.
wines.personalNote: Two days of skin contact create a lightly structured dry Moscato, still floral with honeysuckle and peach, then savory, salty and refreshing.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for delicate aromatic white wine and Sicilian coastal food.
wines.sourceLabel: Il Mortellito official Viaria production details
wines.vintageNote: The producer confirms 100% Moscato di Noto and two days of skin contact.

wines.intro: A Mediterranean red emphasizing salty freshness and savory intrigue alongside supple red fruit.
wines.nose: Ripe red cherry, spice, tobacco and hints of brine.
wines.palate: Smooth, lively and lightly structured, balancing ripe fruit with fresh acidity.
wines.aeration: Try it slightly cool, not warm; a brief chill preserves its bright fruit.
wines.personalNote: Smooth red with savory brine, spice, leather and a salty freshness that refreshes the palate.
wines.pairingBasis: 2022 retailer pairing suggestions include burrata, prosciutto, poultry and pork.
wines.sourceLabel: Il Mortellito Cala Niuru 2022 wine and pairing notes
wines.vintageNote: Producer blend proportions are not perfectly consistent across releases and sources; this is the 2022 Frappato/Nero d'Avola wine.

wines.referenceVintage: Vintage not recorded in your list; pictured 2022
wines.intro: A naturally sparkling, skin-contact Pinot Grigio with a salmon-gold hue and snappy, mineral freshness.
wines.nose: Pink grapefruit, crushed stone and tart apple peel.
wines.palate: Bright, gently fizzy and textured, with subtle skin-contact grip.
wines.aeration: Chill and open gently; no decanting so you retain the bubbles.
wines.personalNote: Slightly sparkling Pinot Grigio made with skin contact; fresh and clean with pink grapefruit, crushed stone and tart apple skin.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for high-acid, lightly sparkling skin-contact wine.
wines.sourceLabel: Furlani Alpino Macerato Pinot Grigio production details
wines.imageVintageNote: The verified image is labeled 2022 Alpino Macerato.
wines.vintageNote: Your original list calls this 'Alpino' but describes 100% Pinot Grigio skin-contact frizzante, which matches Alpino Macerato rather than the standard Alpino white.

wines.grape: Pinot Noir / Gamay (as recorded in your list)
wines.intro: An intensely colored, fragrant Niagara rosé with a pomegranate hue, layered red fruit and invigorating freshness.
wines.nose: Roses, floral perfume, pomegranate and wild berries.
wines.palate: Sumptuous red fruit with a juicy, vinous texture and bright, fresh acidity.
wines.finish: Refreshing and persistent, with red fruit and flowers.
wines.aeration: Serve slightly cool; a larger glass opens the flowers.
wines.personalNote: The list describes a deeply colored, pomegranate-hued rosé with enveloping flowers, succulent red fruit, roses and vivid freshness. It records 53% Pinot Noir and 47% Gamay.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for a structured, deeply colored rosé.
wines.imageVintageNote: Same producer and Roselana cuvée, but photo shows the 2024 bottle rather than the 2023 release.
wines.vintageNote: Grape proportions appear to change across releases; 53/47 is retained as recorded in your original list, not independently confirmed for 2023.

wines.intro: A textural Ontario white blend combining traditional barrel élevage with a portion fermented on skins.
wines.nose: Ripe peach, orange peel, jasmine and honeyed apple.
wines.palate: Aromatic but bone-dry, gently chalky, saline and full of fresh acidity.
wines.aeration: Serve cool rather than ice-cold; a little air helps the aromatics and texture.
wines.personalNote: An aromatic Chardonnay–Viognier blend with a portion fermented on skins, described as graceful, precise and lightly textured.
wines.pairingBasis: Astor Wine suggests Tourtière, while other dishes are sommelier interpretations of the full-bodied textural white.
wines.sourceLabel: SAQ Pearl Morissette Irrévérence 2020 composition and tasting
wines.imageVintageNote: Photo is labeled the 2020 Irrévérence Blanc bottle.
wines.vintageNote: The 2020 blend is reported as about 51% Chardonnay, 26% Viognier, 19% Pinot Noir and 4% Riesling. Later releases have different compositions.
